title: (RHEA-2016:0172) Updated package :: redhat-certification-openstack
portal_summary: An updated redhat-certification-openstack package is now available for Red Hat Enterprise Linux OpenStack Platform 8.0 release.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Certification (for RHEL Server)|Red Hat Certification (for RHEL Server)|7|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update refer: 

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
This update fixes several bugs and adds various enhancements in the redhat-certification-openstack package and its dependent packages. These updates and enhancements are required for the certification of OpenStack components with Red Hat Enterprise Linux OpenStack Platform 8.0 and also for running Rally scenario tests which have been integrated with redhat-certification-openstack. 

The update further improves certification test suite coverage.

Users who need to certify their components with Red Hat Enterprise Linux OpenStack Platform 8.0 are advised to upgrade to this updated redhat-certification-openstack package.
